name: MEC Company Ltd.
blurb: MEC Company Ltd. (TSE: 4971) is a Japanese specialty chemical manufacturer focused exclusively on surface-treatment chemicals for printed circuit boards and IC substrates. Its core products are copper micro-etch and surface-treatment solutions — chemical processes that roughen copper surfaces to improve adhesion between copper traces and the dielectric layers built up in multi-layer PCBs and ABF substrates. MEC holds dominant market share in the copper-etchant chemistry segment for high-end PCB production, a niche with high switching costs and limited qualified alternatives, giving it a degree of pricing power unusual for a process-chemicals company.
recent: MEC reported FY2025 revenue of ¥20.95 billion, up 14.9% year-over-year, driven by accelerating substrate fabrication volumes tied to AI server demand. The company's earnings reportedly delivered 313% year-on-year growth in a recent reporting period, reflecting both volume leverage and improved mix toward higher-margin substrate-grade chemistry. The stock price reached approximately ¥8,670 as of early May 2026.
